info.title: Courtside – Youth Basketball API
info.description:
Admin panel + mobile app API.

**Login:** `POST /user/login` sends an OTP, `POST /user/verify-otp` returns a token. Click **Authorize** and paste the token (without `Bearer`) to call protected routes.

get.description: **Access:** Public (no token)

post.description:
**Access:** Public (no token)

sirf superAdmin signup

```
Sirf SUPER ADMIN ka signup. ClubAdmin aur Coach yahan se nahi bante, unhe superAdmin/clubAdmin banata hai.
body: { firstname, lastname, countryCode, mobileNumber, username?, email? }
```

**Access:** Public (no token)

sab roles

```
body: { countryCode, mobileNumber }
Sab roles ke liye. OTP set karta hai. Resend OTP ke liye bhi yahi.
```

**Access:** Public (no token)

sab roles, token yahin milta hai

```
body: { countryCode, mobileNumber, otp, device_type?, device_token? }
Sahi OTP pe token milta hai, saath mein club { _id, clubCode, name, theme } (har role ke liye, superAdmin ko null).
```

delete.description:
**Access:** Super admin only

```
Default: club ARCHIVE hota hai (isArchived: true), data bacha rehta hai, uske club admins / coaches /
parents login nahi kar paate. Wapas laane ke liye PUT /api/user/restoreClub/:id.
Permanent delete: DELETE /api/user/deleteClub/:id?permanent=true
Permanent delete mein club ke saath:
1. Club admins aur Coaches ke User accounts delete hote hain (user table)
2. ClubAdmin, Coach aur Team records delete hote hain
3. Club ka logo S3 se delete hota hai (purana local file ho toh disk se)
4. Club document delete hota hai (club table)
```

put.description:
**Access:** Super admin only

```
Archived club wapas active, uske users dobara login kar sakte hain.
```

get.description:
**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
Dashboard ke asli counts. superAdmin: saare active (non-archived) clubs. clubAdmin: sirf apna club.
players = status "active" wale. response: { totals: { clubs, players, teams, coaches, parents }, clubs: [{ _id, name, logoUrl, players, teams, coaches }] }
```

**Access:** Super admin or club admin

versions + current, clubAdmin apne club ka

```

response: { current: { version, content, ... } | null, versions: [...], parentsTotal, requiredVersion }
```

post.description:
**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
Body: { name, clubId, categoryId, gender?, teamType?, season?, teamCapacity?, coachId?, status?,
        associationNumber?, leagueClassificationNumber?   (sirf league, optional. non-league par null)
        homeVenueId?, preferredTrainingDays?,
        unavailableHours?: [{ day, from, to }],
        athleticsTraining?: { enabled, locationName, day, from, to } }
Response ke "coachMatch" mein coach aur team ke din kitne milte hain (warning ke saath).
Rule: league team par aisa coach nahi lag sakta jo pehle se doosri league team ka coach hai (409).
```

put.description:
**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
Body: { name?, clubId?, categoryId?, gender?, teamType?, season?, teamCapacity?, coachId?, status?,
        associationNumber?, leagueClassificationNumber?   (sirf league. team non-league bani toh dono null)
        homeVenueId?, preferredTrainingDays?, unavailableHours?, athleticsTraining? }
homeVenueId: "" = venue hatana.  preferredTrainingDays / unavailableHours: [] = sab hatana (poori list replace).
athleticsTraining: { enabled: false } = band karna.
Response ke "coachMatch" mein coach aur team ke din kitne milte hain.
Rule: league team par aisa coach nahi lag sakta jo pehle se doosri league team ka coach hai (409).
      Ye check tab chalta hai jab coach badle ya team league bane. Purane data par baaki edit rukte nahi.
```

(superAdmin ya clubAdmin)

Isi team ke CLUB ke woh players jo IS team mein NAHI hain:

Team page pe "doosri team se player add / move karo" ke liye.

**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
Kapdon ke size ki ginti (bulk order ke liye): har size ke saamne game / training / winter kitne players.
status na do toh inactive / left players nahi ginte. teamId=none: jin players ki koi team nahi.
response: { sizes: [{ size, gameWearSize, trainingWearSize, winterWearSize }], notSet: {...}, totals: {...}, totalPlayers }
```

post.description:
**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
Pehle se bane EK YA ZYADA players ko ek team mein daalna. Naya player NAHI banta.
Player bina team ka ho ya kisi doosri team mein ho, dono chalega (doosri team se move ho jayega).
Har player ka purana shirt number aur status rehta hai.
body: { teamId, playerIds: ["id1", "id2", "id3"] }
Har player alag se check hota hai. Jo sahi hain wo assign, jinme problem hai wo "failed" mein wajah ke saath.
```

**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
JSON ya multipart/form-data (file ke saath). Multipart mein parents JSON string mein bhejo.
idDocument (file, optional): JPG / PNG / PDF, max 5MB
body: {
  playerType: "youth" (default) | "senior"
  firstname, lastname, birthDate, gender, idNumber?, email?, countryCode?, mobileNumber?,   -> User
    (senior ke liye mobileNumber zaroori)
  clubId (sirf superAdmin), teamId?, season?, shirtNumber?, status?, medicalNotes?,         -> Player
  gameWearSize?, trainingWearSize?, winterWearSize?                                         -> Player
  parents (sirf youth, zaroori): [{ firstname, lastname, countryCode, mobileNumber, email?, relation?, isPrimary? }]
}
```
